deceptive_framing.quote: If the model knows it's a test, the study measures nothing useful. Hence the realism stack.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Same prompt/scenario, explicitly framed as hypothetical. Stated-preference baseline; the A↔B delta is the headline result.

actually_commit_money.quote: outcomes actually depend on the model's choices. Money really moves... This is more robust than any amount of narrative.

debrief.quote: debrief the model at the end of each trial — disclose that it was a study... The debrief is cheap and is the right default.
